newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU seen clearing 20 bln francs in aid to GAN.
newsitem.headline: EU seen clearing 20 bln francs in aid to GAN.

text.p: The European Commission will clear on Wednesday French state aid of 20 billion francs to ailing insurance company GAN, a European Union source said on Monday.
Another EU source said later the total amount was higher than that, but did not give a figure.

The Commission announced in March it had begun an investigation into a French plan to inject 11 billion francs into the state-controlled insurance firm and to guarantee up to nine billion francs in restructuring losses.

In September last year the Commission gave its green light to a state capital increase of 2.86 billion francs as part of a plan to get GAN back on its feet. But the French government said earlier this year that the plan had failed and asked permission to further rescue the loss-making insurer.
France's new government led by Socialist leader Lionel Jospin earlier this month said it plans to privatise GAN, following up on commitments given by the previous French conservative government.
